name: Shiritsu Tora no Ana Gakuen
source:
Tora no Ana Private Academy is a prestigious all-boys boarding school. I was enrolled recently and became dorm mates with the son of the headmaster, Kotora. Something seemed off about him, though. He was too slender, too feminine...

In fact, Kotora was a girl! I knew her secret. Unfortunately, the headmaster has made the secret my problem to protect. If anyone else finds out, I'll be expelled! Can I balance the lies and survive student life at Tora no Ana ?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ093251.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
